fields.Name: T134 - Communication Providers
fields.Description: Verifies the Communication app's Providers section renders the providers list/configuration view without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Providers section. Confirm the providers list or configuration view renders correctly, showing provider entries or a valid empty-state. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Communication app is open with the Providers section selected
The providers list or configuration view renders (provider entries or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
